data_fields.name: total_per_row
data_fields.donor_constant: spawn.total, integer copies placed at boot per random-point row; never enforced again

data_fields.name: respawn_s
data_fields.donor_constant: spawn.respawn, integer seconds (e.g. 40 in c4_garden_of_beasts.json, 120 in c4_catacomb_of_dark_omen.json)

data_fields.name: bias_s
data_fields.donor_constant: spawn.bias, integer seconds; jitter band is respawn plus or minus bias (0 in the rows read)

data_fields.name: period
data_fields.donor_constant: spawn.period enum always|day|night; anything else reads as always

data_fields.name: despawn_empty_grace_s
data_fields.donor_constant: absent in donor (no idle despawn found)

best_idea: A per-death respawn timer per spawn slot, with a jitter band (respawn plus or minus bias seconds), that re-checks a period revision before placing the replacement.
decision_why: Take the death-to-respawn timer with jitter and the 10 s spawn grace as zone data and engine logic; add the population cap and empty-zone despawn that the donor lacks, since row 23 needs both.
acceptance: A server test spawns one wolf in a zone row with respawn 40 and bias 0, kills it at t=0, and asserts no replacement at 39.9 s and exactly one at 40 s at one of the row's listed points; a new wolf does not engage a player in range until 10 s have passed.
